'''Leatherback's''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] in [[Meirm city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] operated by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Leatherback (Weequay)|Leatherback]]. When business declined during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] Leatherback had to get rid of his [[Bartender droid/Legends|bartender droid]], but still employed a middle-aged [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] to dance on a stage.<ref name="LCaL" />
